ladder.summary: Looks at something and changes nothing.
examples: ls, cat, git status, git log

ladder.summary: Creates or changes files or state on this machine, in a way git or a backup can undo.
Destroys data, or discards work that has no copy.
Sends data to another system or person, or changes state there. Cannot be taken back by the sender.
examples: an MCP tool that creates or sends

ladder.summary: Publishes or releases something that other people or systems will run or read.
examples: netlify deploy, kubectl apply, terraform apply
an MCP tool that generates media
